description: This file defines the InterestRateChartSlabFields class, a Java entity class used in the domain model of interest rate charts within a financial software system. It encapsulates fields and behaviors related to interest rate slabs, including validation, comparison, and overlap detection logic for interest rate slabs based on periods and amounts.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabFields
classes.description: An embeddable domain class representing the fields of a slab in an interest rate chart, including methods for validation, comparison, overlap detection, and updates based on commands.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to create a new InterestRateChartSlabFields instance with specified field values.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the fields of this interest rate chart slab based on a JsonCommand, tracking changes and performing validation.

methods.name: validateChartSlabPlatformRules
methods.description: Validates logical rules for the chart slab, such as fromPeriod not being greater than toPeriod and amount ranges.

methods.name: isFromPeriodGreaterThanToPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the fromPeriod value exceeds toPeriod.

methods.name: isAmountRangeFromGreaterThanTo
methods.description: Checks if the amountRangeFrom exceeds amountRangeTo.

methods.name: periodType
methods.description: Returns the period type enumeration value.

methods.name: isRateChartHasGap
methods.description: Determines if there is a gap between this slab and another based on period and amount boundaries.

methods.name: isValidChart
methods.description: Checks if the current chart configuration is valid based on grouping criteria.

methods.name: isNotProperChartStart
methods.description: Checks if the slab start boundaries are improperly defined.

methods.name: isRateChartOverlapping
methods.description: Checks if this slab overlaps with another slab based on periods and amounts.

methods.name: depositPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the deposit period in units (days, weeks, months, years) between two dates based on period type.

methods.name: isAmountBetween
methods.description: Verifies if a deposit amount falls within this slab's amount range.

methods.name: isPeriodBetween
methods.description: Checks if a given period value is within the slab's period boundaries.
